articles.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
articles.description: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

articles.title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
articles.description: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.

articles.title: Indian opposition MPs detained in protest against election chief
articles.description: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.

articles.title: Yemeni military says it has 'secured' Red Sea waterway
articles.description: Saudi-backed forces gave conflicting reports of whether they had also seized the port city of Mokha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

articles.title: Nigeria mourns 25 killed as military plane crashes into swamp
articles.description: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.

articles.title: Separatist party projected to win Quebec election, adding new test to Canada's unity
articles.description: The Parti Québécois, which secured a minority, has vowed to hold an independence referendum in the years to come.

articles.title: Fear and disruption for Ukraine's rail passengers as Russia escalates drone attacks
articles.description: Ukrainians travelling by train are increasingly caught in the crosshairs of Russia's attacks.

articles.title: Spanish PM calls snap election
articles.description: Spain's prime minister Pedro Sanchez has called a snap election for next month.
